latest.title: PSP Alpha 1 — original experimental preview
latest.summary: This is the original PPSSPP v1.20.4 preview APK, not the newer corrective candidate. It has known image scaling/positioning and game-library import/discovery issues. The PSP-only development branch now contains an OmniCore-owned image presentation fix, conservative smart internal-resolution selection, a graphics menu, saved 1×/2×/automatic resolution choice, and configurable touch-control size, opacity and intelligent opacity. The latest build is being validated in CI; physical-device validation remains pending. A native Vulkan backend is planned but is not implemented in this release.

next_update.title: PSP graphics and touch-control configuration
next_update.status: In development — CI running; physical-device verification pending
next_update.summary: The PSP branch adds aspect-preserving framebuffer presentation, conservative device-aware resolution selection, persistent graphics resolution settings, touch-control size and opacity controls, and intelligent opacity. Vulkan is a separate future backend task and must not be presented as supported until it is genuinely implemented and tested.
